mapper.select: SELECT e.enrollment_no AS enrollmentNo , e.enrollment_status AS enrollmentStatus , e.createdate , c.course_no AS courseNo , c.course_name AS courseName , c.course_score AS courseScore , c.course_capacity AS courseCapacity , u.user_name AS professorName , t.course_time_yoil AS courseTimeYoil , t.course_time_start AS courseTimeStart , t.course_time_end AS courseTimeEnd FROM tb_enrollment e INNER JOIN tb_course c ON c.course_no = e.course_no INNER JOIN tb_sysuser u ON u.user_no = c.professor_user_no INNER JOIN tb_course_time t ON t.course_no = c.course_no WHERE e.student_user_no = #{studentUserNo} AND e.enrollment_status = 0 ORDER BY e.enrollment_no DESC LIMIT #{startRow}, #{rowPerPage}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_enrollment WHERE student_user_no = #{studentUserNo} AND enrollment_status = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_enrollment e JOIN tb_course_time ct1 ON e.course_no = ct1.course_no JOIN tb_course_time ct2 ON ct2.course_no = #{courseNo} WHERE e.student_user_no = #{studentUserNo} AND e.enrollment_status = 0 AND ct1.course_time_yoil = ct2.course_time_yoil AND ( (ct1.course_time_start <= ct2.course_time_end) AND (ct1.course_time_end >= ct2.course_time_start) )
